purpose: Versioned selective source index with a growing cross-disciplinary syllabus. A 10x / 100x literature ambition is an explicit target, never counted as works already read.

statuses.catalogued: Reference registered for reading; no claim of having read its paper, book, recording or full text.
statuses.abstract-reviewed: Publisher/primary abstract, overview or archival summary inspected and summarized, but full text NOT read. Does not count as a completed study.
statuses.partially-studied: Requires dated reading notes citing specific sections and a named research session.
statuses.fully-studied: Requires versioned notes on the whole work, methods, limitations, citations and a session log.

methods.influenceRule: A work influences the measured single-history vs many-histories direction only if it demonstrates a verifiable prediction that differentiates candidates after alternatives and dependencies are considered. Bibliographic influence alone has no compass impact.
methods.countingRule: Only 'fully-studied' records count as completed full works; abstracts and catalogue entries are separate. Avoid duplicated counts for same DOI or coauthored work; count per work once and per field once.
methods.notesRule: Advance a work only with source ID, exact section/pages, study date, researcher/session, claim, methods, limitations, alternative interpretations and evidence-led impact reason.
methods.datePrecision: A catalogue entry's year is publication year, not the date personally studied.

scholarIdentityAudit.preservation: No researcher work lists/names/field mappings altered; only later-collision entries re-keyed. Existing earlier R-055 Thomas Kuhn, R-056 Daniel Kahneman, R-057 Amos Tversky preserved unchanged. No source count or study-depth credit changes.
scholarIdentityAudit.validation: Truth Engine v0.2 automated ID tests required

verdictAudit.empiricalConclusion: Physically actual one-versus-many histories remains experimentally unresolved. XENON/Ge published radiation constraints and LISA reported force-noise bounds narrow white-noise CSL parameter domains. Independent R008 source-input reconstructions reproduce Ge 95% Bayesian and LISA Eq10 numerical limits, while molecule and angular limits remain source-only. Everett vs quantum-equilibrium Bohm ordinary Born predictions are operationally equivalent. Editorial 50 is NOT a 50% probability.
verdictAudit.initialScoreExplanation: Historical 59 was an unsupported +9 editorial preference inherited from pre-project discussion. VC-010 on 2026-10-21 resets to neutral editorial 50 as a methodology correction, NOT experimental support for one history nor 50% probability. Earlier 59 events remain preserved.

changeLog.justification: The cited works are important to relativity, measurement or hypothetical loop consistency but do not supply direct discriminating physical evidence for timeline multiplicity. Indexing alone cannot shift an editorial meter.

changeLog.trigger: Twelve additional verified bibliographic records and four new abstract-level critical notes
changeLog.justification: The wormhole model is conditional, the collapse model is a proposed alternative, the Wigner-friend inequality result requires specific assumptions, and large-molecule interference tests coherence; none presently distinguishes a physical plurality of histories from a single realized history. New bibliography and abstract-level review therefore increase scientific coverage but not the editorial verdict.

changeLog.trigger: Targeted primary-paper section-level reading of Gödel, Hawking and Deutsch; abstract-level counterchecks of Politzer and Lloyd et al.
changeLog.justification: Gödel supplies an exact CTC spacetime, not an observation. Hawking's formation obstruction has specific energy/horizon assumptions and semiclassical caveats; Deutsch proves a fixed-point result given a CTC rather than establishing one. Politzer and Lloyd expose model dependence. None directly measures or distinguishes the count of physically realized histories; 59 is editorial and not an empirical probability.

changeLog.trigger: Independent limited algebra checks of Gödel's circular-orbit sign and Deutsch-style one-bit channel fixed points
changeLog.justification: Replicating the radius threshold and self-consistent 2x2 density-matrix toy verifies conditional mathematics of stipulated models but supplies no physical detection of real CTCs or multiple quantum histories. No measurable discrimination; no score adjustment.

changeLog.trigger: Source-level partial study of KRW horizon theorem, Visser reliability objections and Hawking assumptions; Roman-ring abstract countercheck
changeLog.justification: KRW proves mathematical obstruction to standard linear quantum fields at base points of compactly generated Cauchy horizons, while Visser questions reliability of semiclassical-backreaction predictions. These qualified theoretical findings neither demonstrate a constructed CTC nor empirically distinguish one realized history from Everett branching. The editorial indicator cannot be updated for source volume or mathematical difficulty.

changeLog.trigger: Shift core inquiry to one actual physical timeline versus multiple; six primary source-review themes and PBR scope check
changeLog.justification: Everett, Bohm and collapse models differ in interpretation and sometimes predictions but currently reviewed Bell, coherence and CMB results do not uniquely count actual branches. Bubble cosmology differs from quantum branching. The old 59/100 compass remains non-probabilistic editorial orientation.

changeLog.trigger: Ten source-level complete main-text critical reviews and limited theoretical/mathematical sanity checks
changeLog.justification: Critical reviews of Bell, PBR, Everett/SEP, causal-process formalism, photon quantum switches, Bell-Wigner experiment, single-outcome rebuttal, Gödel, Hawking and bubble-CMB tests yield mathematical theorems and model-dependent observations, none uniquely distinguishing the number of physically actual quantum histories. A higher count of reviewed papers is progress in scholarship, not numerical likelihood of many worlds.

changeLog.trigger: Original Bohm I+II and 2016 Hensen second Bell main-text full reviews; Everett/Bohm/GRW/CSL model comparison; 2026 XENONnT parameter-targeted source checks
changeLog.justification: Quantum-equilibrium Bohmian mechanics (one actual configuration) and Everettian unitary dynamics (multiple emergent relative states) agree on ordinary Born measurements. Bell tests constrain local hidden-variable classes, and 2026 XENONnT limits are conditional on specific altered collapse dynamics. Neither theory-only toy calculation nor reading new papers constitutes a history-count experiment. Compass 59 remains inherited editorial, not calibrated probability.

changeLog.trigger: Complete six-section Everett 1957 original-main-text critical review and GRW 1986 original publisher abstract scope audit, plus release allocation evidence protocol
changeLog.justification: Everett 1957 explicitly treats branch terms as actual within universal unitary theory and derives a positive additive squared-amplitude measure for typical memory records. This defines a model and conceptual justification, not physical direct observation of branch multiplicity; equilibrium Bohm predicts the same Born records with one actual configuration. GRW 1986 targeted record was not full study. New source coverage and release plan do not support empirical score change; legacy 59 is editorial, not probability.

changeLog.trigger: User question about unearned +9 from neutral 50 and serial frozen meter, plus source-critical exact model-specific XENONnT test.
changeLog.justification: Original 59 was explicitly inherited as editorial and lacks a reproducible nine-point many-real-histories calculation, especially after the primary question changed. Remove unsupported +9 and present neutral 50 for display only, NOT 50% prior odds or 9-point evidence favoring one. Separately, full original 2026 XENONnT source review quantifies meaningful Markovian CSL parameter exclusions but does not differentiate Everett's physically many actual branches from equilibrium Bohm's one actual configuration. Historical nine no-change VC records preserved.

changeLog.trigger: Ten strategically selected original full main texts, measured model parameter exclusions, shared-LISA controls and theory discriminator counterexamples
changeLog.justification: Scientific ledger advanced six named model propositions (MOVE-002–007), including true molecule and germanium observations, existing LISA rotational/translational reanalysis, spectral cutoff parameter qualifications and explicit theoretical countermodels. No reviewed experiment has a different likelihood for matched standard Everett vs equilibrium Bohm histories, so the neutral 50 editorial compass must not be pushed toward either ontology. This is a substantive scientific advance without arbitrary central scoring.

changeLog.trigger: Independent published-input 95% Ge gamma posterior reconstruction and 2024 LISA acceleration-noise parameter calculation, source-level common white-noise CSL bound comparison
changeLog.justification: A genuine advance in computation/audit reproducibility validates conditional parameter claims: Donadi published 95%-credible bound is reproduced at 5.1973236e-13 using BOTH signal/background +1 counts; Dai LISA conservative PSD calculation yields 8.364e-11 using published geometry. XENON 90%-CL paper ratio converts to 3e-17 at rC=1e-7 without detector likelihood replication. Interferometric molecules and LISA torque remain non-digitized. These tests differentiate modified stochastic dynamics from unitary quantum behavior in model-specific limits, not actual-history ontology of Everett versus quantum-equilibrium Bohm. Neutral 50 remains editorial, not probability.
